d: Iran is showcasing its military capabilities despite US claims of extensive destruction. A Western intelligence assessment reportedly estimates that Tehran produces around 50 ballistic missiles monthly and retains at least 1,700 missiles. Iran claims its Fattah-2 hypersonic missile can evade enemy air defences, although its combat use remains unverified. Meanwhile, the IRGC unveils an underground missile city housing ballistic and cruise missiles.
